summary: Small teams with few secrets can use one vault password, while larger teams can use multiple passwords per user, access level, file, directory or environment, selecting the right one at run time with vault IDs.
questions: Should I use separate vault passwords for dev and production?
When does a single vault password make sense?
How do I pick the right vault password per environment when running a playbook?

answer_card.title: One vault password or many?
answer_card.answer_md:
- **Single password**: fine for small teams or few secrets. Store it securely in a file or secret manager.
- **Multiple passwords**: better for larger teams or many secrets, e.g. per user, access level, file, directory or environment. For example, dev and prod vars files encrypted with different passwords; at run time you choose the right one with a **vault ID**.
